title: mentha arvensis f. subrotunda
intro: Mentha arvensis f. subrotunda, commonly known as Japanese peppermint, is a variety of the wild mint plant. It is a perennial herb that belongs to the Lamiaceae family, known for its aromatic and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Mentha arvensis f. subrotunda include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce nausea, and alleviate headaches. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as menthone, limonene, and menthol, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
